text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard El's voice...
and a lot of

cheering.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She's incredible... She's always on the
mic and
pumping up the crowd,
bragging about how she's
gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El's commitment to winning is really
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But I'm not gonna let that stop me!
